caption: The drawing depicts a central figure of a person sitting on a swing, suspended by two ropes held in both hands. The person is wearing a green upper garment with long sleeves, a white skirt adorned with green decorative elements, and a matching green hat with a small feather or ribbon. The background is predominantly light blue, featuring a pattern of large, light pink and white flowers with green leaves dispersed throughout. There are also white floral motifs and decorative flourishes filling the space around the figure and flowers. The composition has a symmetrical and balanced arrangement, with the swing and figure positioned centrally and surrounded by blooming flowers and leaves on all sides. The color palette is mainly composed of blues, greens, pinks, and whites, with brown outlines and accents.
